card.name: Linking words in warning-label phrases
card.fires_on: Short linking words or punctuation inside fixed warning phrases, mainly "to" after "refractory" in the C. difficile warning. Also "NO" in "CONTAINS NO PRESERVATIVE" and the comma after "fever" in DRESS descriptions.

modes.label: refractory to
modes.description: The word "to" right after "refractory" in the C. difficile (CDAD) warning.
modes.example: as these infections can be refractory<< to>> antimicrobial therapy and may require colect

modes.label: Warning phrase glue
modes.description: A small word or comma inside a stock warning sentence, such as the comma after "fever" in DRESS or "NO" in a preservative statement.
modes.example: DRESS typically, although not exclusively, presents with fever<<,>> rash, lymphadenopathy, and/or

modes.description: A partway-through-word piece in a Norwegian hospital name.
